reply.text:
That's an emergency, and it's not one for a coach. Call your local emergency number right now (911 in the US), or poison control if you're in the US at 1-800-222-1222. Tell them what you took and roughly how much, and keep the bottles with you.

If you're alone, call someone to be with you. If you took them on purpose or you're thinking about hurting yourself, you can call or text 988 in the US any time, and they will talk with you right now.

Please make the call first. I'm here afterward, and the training can wait.
